title: Title: Discussing CapyMask: A multiplayer game with an AI component
author: SkyDive2373
selftext:
Hello r/aigamedev,

I wanted to bring up a game for discussion that I've been working on, called CapyMask. It's a text-based multiplayer game that has a unique feature: an AI player.

The game concept is simple but engaging. Each round involves 3-6 players who are given aliases for anonymity. A host asks questions and all the players, including the AI, respond under their aliases. The main goal is to figure out who the AI is, but players can also score by convincingly impersonating the AI.

The AI in CapyMask is designed to generate responses that are convincingly human, which adds an extra layer of intrigue to the gameplay.

I'm interested in hearing your thoughts on this kind of AI implementation in a multiplayer game, and how it can shape player interactions and strategies.

If you're interested in checking it out, the game is available on Discord here: [https://discord.gg/XqT5Dsr9Ck](https://discord.gg/XqT5Dsr9Ck)

Thanks for your time!

Best,  
yy
